candidate: THINK+mixer AH+PM / restricted dynamic 50:50 ranks; ten seeds; five issuers; 20% basket volatility target
candidate_chosen_from: Prior October 26 historical study, before this matched-control study; retain it regardless of new control results
ranking: Within each family average eligible percentile ranks across all ten seeds, then average the two families 50:50. Select five issuers by best share-class score; average-rank/tie budgets as frozen issuer_weights.

exposure.volatility: Sample SD of prior 20 daily economic constituent returns under the current proposed basket weights, annualized sqrt(252), 5% vol floor; weekly only

universe: Reviewed as-published monthly NASDAQ-100 membership, original eligibility and liquidity rules, both networks using the same fixed supported stock-ID order
unsupported_id_policy: Fail the entire prospective signal and pause collection before outcomes if an otherwise eligible member has an unsupported ID. Do not silently drop names, append random mixer weights, or score a changed universe. Any repair requires a new policy version before a new confirmation start.
refit: Annual only, first eligible exchange session of each year. Train from max(2019-07-01, Jan 1 of Y-5) through Y-2; validate Y-1, purge outcomes crossing both boundaries. For Y=2026: train 2021-2024, validate 2025. Exact architecture/optimizer/checkpoint/imputation rules below. Refit all ten seeds in both families; no return-based seed/checkpoint selection.

config/ndx_extended_hours_20261024.json.purpose: User-authorized matched test of after-hours and premarket information with regular-session execution
config/ndx_extended_hours_20261024.json.seed_rule: Original five plus the first five in the previously frozen 20-new-seed list, in protocol order; no return-based seed selection. Primary equal-rank ensemble uses all ten; original-five and new-five subgroup results are diagnostics.
config/ndx_extended_hours_20261024.json.data: Reuse and hash-verify the 1288 literal-ticker raw SIP 15-minute chunks, exchange calendar, issuer-date rules and reviewed historical daily economic panel. No new universe, outcome or eligibility filtering.
config/ndx_extended_hours_20261024.json.after_hours: Signal session regular close (13:00 on early closes, otherwise 16:00) through 20:00 America/New_York. Include only complete 15-minute bars ending by cutoff.
config/ndx_extended_hours_20261024.json.premarket: Following EXCHANGE SESSION from 04:00 through 09:15 America/New_York, attached to the preceding daily signal index. This includes Monday premarket after Friday and skips exchange holidays.
config/ndx_extended_hours_20261024.json.decision_time: All three views form share orders at 09:20 ET on the entry session, using bars ending no later than 09:15. Share sizing deliberately uses the preceding regular close's known NAV, prices and ADV, preserving the existing accounting formula. It does not use premarket marks or pretend the forecast existed at the previous close.
config/ndx_extended_hours_20261024.json.execution: Those fixed share orders fill at the SAME ENTRY SESSION regular close; all data cutoffs precede it. Original five-session close-to-close targets, continuous $1m accounts, cancellation, cash scaling, 1% ADV limits, acquisition approximations and final liquidation remain unchanged. No extended-hours executions.
config/ndx_extended_hours_20261024.json.feature_semantics: AH return anchors to the same-date raw closing regular-session bar; PM return is within that premarket window. No cross-date raw price gap or share-volume ratio is used, avoiding split/rename discontinuities without future corporate-action information. Dollar notional, coverage and first/last activity age accompany prices.
config/ndx_extended_hours_20261024.json.sparse_data: At least four positive-volume, positive-trade-count on-grid bars are needed for the seven numeric summaries. Coverage and trade ages are always available; no trades gives coverage=0 and both ages=1. Missing numeric inputs use TRAIN-ONLY means, never forward fill or drop a member/outcome. Sparse trading is not certified as vendor completeness.
config/ndx_extended_hours_20261024.json.architecture: Original five-input THINK+mixer core plus identical shared per-stock 320-to-16-to-1 auxiliary branches for all three views. Auxiliary output head starts at zero; bounded eligible-centered correction is half detached core-score SD times centered tanh. Daily control bypasses the auxiliary branch exactly. Both core and auxiliary parameters learn jointly for augmented views; this is not the preceding frozen-core correction experiment.
config/ndx_extended_hours_20261024.json.matching: Core initialization, optimizer, training order, loss, graph and checkpoint selection match the original five-feature experiment. Daily control must reproduce all 40 available original/seed-expansion annual validation/test exports and selected epochs. All three parameter inventories are identical; daily has unused auxiliary capacity.
config/ndx_extended_hours_20261024.json.input_scaling: Core uses original train-only standardization, clipping at eight SD and scale 0.2. Auxiliary channels use training-eligible finite observations only, same clipping and scale; flatten 16 x 20 features per stock. AH view pads PM channels; daily pads all extra channels.
config/ndx_extended_hours_20261024.json.target_and_loss: Observed five-session stock economic returns in percentage points; original masked global MSE per chronological batch.
config/ndx_extended_hours_20261024.json.checkpoint_selection: Earliest best prior-year validation MSE improvement exceeding 1e-7; no test metric used. Same original purged annual indices for every view.
config/ndx_extended_hours_20261024.json.primary_comparison: Ten-seed after_hours minus daily, fixed equal top ten, full exposure and base modeled costs. after_hours_premarket minus after_hours tests incremental premarket information. Neither view is selected by test returns.
config/ndx_extended_hours_20261024.json.accounts: 66 accounts: each view's ten-seed/original-five/new-five ensemble at three costs (27), each individual seed at base costs (30), SPY/QQQ buy-and-hold at three costs (6), monthly index basket at three costs (3).
config/ndx_extended_hours_20261024.json.confidence: 10000 joint daily circular-block samples, blocks 5/20/60. Primary 20. One nine-contrast active-mean family covers each primary view versus SPY and QQQ (six), AH minus daily, AH+PM minus daily and AH+PM minus AH (three). Original-five contrasts are disclosed separately as diagnostics. Pointwise absolute Sharpe intervals use the same methodology as the comparison workbook, with a 3% annual hurdle.
config/ndx_extended_hours_20261024.json.stop_rule: Review features, pass tests and freeze data/source/protocol before all 120 fits. Finish and hash-lock every fit before new test financial/ranking metrics. Independently reproduce all checkpoints, data timing, daily baselines and accounts; publish every view, seed group, seed, cost and negative outcome.
config/ndx_extended_hours_20261024.json.history: 2022-2025 has been repeatedly inspected. This is exploratory development, not unseen confirmation or evidence of guaranteed future superiority. No trades or recurring jobs.

latest/config/ndx_reference_networks_202.purpose: Commit-pinned author neural networks transferred to reviewed NASDAQ monthly membership and identical execution rules; no claim to reproduce paper benchmarks
latest/config/ndx_reference_networks_202.fit_budget: 120 annual seed fits; PRISM has two separately checkpointed training stages. No expansion or hyperparameter selection from test outcomes.
latest/config/ndx_reference_networks_202.checkpoint_rule: Earliest prior-year validation raw-return MSE improvement >1e-7; PRISM representation stage uses author's reconstruction+VQ+0.0001*future prediction objective. Maximum 30 epochs and patience six for each stage, explicitly different from paper training budgets.
latest/config/ndx_reference_networks_202.common_inputs: Same 25 stock channels as parent: five daily and twenty AH+PM channels, same sixteen-session window, train-only normalization and imputation, same 09:15 cutoff / 09:20 decision / next regular-close fill, same five-session target in percentage points. Labels never determine the inference cross-section. This replaces Alpha158 or each paper's original features and horizon conventions.
latest/config/ndx_reference_networks_202.master: Author MASTER classes unchanged: width256, temporal heads4, spatial heads2, dropout0.5, gate temperature5. Additional ten market channels are the same five daily features for SPY/QQQ through preceding regular close. Adam LR1e-5, no weight decay, per-date updates. Market indices/features differ from the China paper.
latest/config/ndx_reference_networks_202.dynamic_restricted: Author layers and architecture unchanged at width32, heads4, learned hyperedges64, dropout0.1, weighted-sum fusion; Adam LR1e-4, RMSE training objective. Explicitly restricted static input: one correlation-group wavelet snapshot from training-only historical member returns, replacing the author's five sector/lead-lag snapshots. No reviewed point-in-time NASDAQ sector history is available. All-active adapter must match author forward; inference masks inactive nodes and static propagation. This is NOT a full faithful SPF pipeline reproduction.
latest/config/ndx_reference_networks_202.prism: Author 128-dimensional VQ encoder, 512 codes, two-stage VQVAE then factor-loading predictor, eight experts/topfour and 13 authentic JKP USA daily vw_cap themes. JKP lag-one twenty-session cumulative features follow author construction. Author optimizer AdamW LR1e-4 wd1e-5 and five-percent linear warmup/cosine schedule, per-date updates. Sequence16 requires decoder initial_T4 and predictor length16. Future stage-one targets are entry to entry+h, h1..10; purge ten-session outcomes separately at both fold boundaries. Retain all current eligible nodes with missing supervision masked by author loss. Stage-two representation forced to eval across outer train calls to honor author freeze intent and prevent codebook mutation. Disable Transformer fastpath because author RMSNorm is not LayerNorm. No author checkpoints loaded.
latest/config/ndx_reference_networks_202.factor_limitations: Downloaded current JKP vintage covers through 2025-12-31; time-lagged data are not verified historical publication vintages. Factor revisions and publication delay remain limitations, and no 2026 factor feed is available from this snapshot. No fresh-period validity claim.
latest/config/ndx_reference_networks_202.ensemble_methods: Parent AH+PM fixed AdamW/MSE plus three reference adapters; additionally predeclare one equal-weight rank blend between each reference and parent. Each annual seed model is combined by eligible cross-sectional percentile ranks. Primary ten-seed; original/new five diagnostic. Blends average the two ensemble rank scores exactly 50/50, never choose weights from test returns.
latest/config/ndx_reference_networks_202.accounts: Seven methods x three seed groups x K5/K10 x base/double/quadruple costs =126; four pure networks including parent x ten individual seeds at K10/base =40; SPY/QQQ x three costs =6; total172 accounts. No individual blend-seed account. Same parent NAV, corporate actions, liquidity caps and cash constraints.
latest/config/ndx_reference_networks_202.inference: 10000 paired circular-block resamples at 5/20/60 sessions, primary20. Fixed ten-seed family: seven methods vs SPY/QQQ (14), six new methods vs parent (6), three blends vs respective standalone reference (3), total23. Report paired SR/CAGR and simultaneous-family uncertainty. Repeatedly inspected 2022-2025 exploratory history.
latest/config/ndx_reference_networks_202.complementarity: Raw forecast residual correlation in common percentage-point units for pure networks, mean per-date score/rank correlation, net and QQQ-active return correlations, top-ten holding overlap; no test-fitted blend.
latest/config/ndx_reference_networks_202.confirmation_gate: No deployment from development ranking. Require consistency across both fixed seed halves and ten-seed ensemble; cost stress; paired comparisons; a separately frozen candidate, refit/execution/membership/cold-start policy and genuinely untouched prospective period. Existing reservation no earlier than 2026-10-21 with first formal read after252sessions has not matured and is not claimed as confirmation. Do not inspect 2026 returns here.
latest/config/ndx_reference_networks_202.scope: Chat results only; no new documents, spreadsheet changes, trades or automations. Imported author sources pinned and hashed before any candidate training. Neural smoke tests may use synthetic data but no financial test metrics before all120fits locked. Stop and disclose failures instead of changing frozen recipes.

execution: Rank every fifth eligible exchange session from the activated first entry. Features through prior close plus AH and current PM bars ending <=09:15 ET; freeze orders at 09:20 ET; execute same session regular close (13:00 ET for an early close). Size shares using preceding-close NAV/marks/20-day ADV. Retain 1% ADV caps, cancellations, sell-first cash scaling, corporate actions and modeled fees.
fees: Per dollar traded: .0007 + .0003*sqrt(participation/.01); participation=abs(notional)/prior-close ADV. $1m reference account. Base/2x/4x costs; taxes excluded. Cash earns zero. No terminal liquidation before the fixed evaluation end.
start: First eligible exchange session strictly after actual activation and after this freeze; no earlier than 2026-10-28. No backfilling missed forecasts or claiming already elapsed dates as prospective.
primary_comparator: QQQ own 20-session/20% volatility target, same five-session calendar, close execution, costs and zero-interest cash
primary_endpoint: Net annualized arithmetic active return versus primary comparator, two-sided paired 20-session circular-block 95% CI. Report paired Sharpe and CAGR differences separately, not as substitutes for the primary endpoint.
evaluation: One formal read after 252 completed exchange sessions. No return-based early stopping, model replacement, parameter search or interim performance inspection. Operational input/timestamp/missing-signal/cost monitoring is permitted. Five/60-session block sensitivity and all seed diagnostics are secondary.
interpretation: 252 sessions may be underpowered; a positive point estimate alone is insufficient. Report failures, gaps and intervals. Prior search uncertainty remains disclosed.
prediction_records: Append-only dated records of complete universe, raw family scores, seed ranks, blend, weights, exposure, order quantities, feature cutoffs, model hashes and pre-decision input hashes. Save and externally timestamp/hash-anchor before 09:20 ET and before execution/outcomes. Reject late or replacement records; missing record invalidates the scheduled signal.
activation_requirements: Fresh reviewed point-in-time membership, issuer identities, actions and daily/AH/PM feeds
Audit feature publication latency, revisions and complete pre-decision timestamps
Refit/verify all 20 current-year models with purged validation and supported stock IDs
Replay and smoke-test future-date inference/execution plumbing before outcomes
Separate append-only prediction store and independent pre-outcome timestamp anchor
Record activation timestamp and verified exchange-session calendar before first signal
activity: Policy preparation only. No 2026 market observations read, fresh models trained, prospective predictions collected, live orders, or scheduled jobs.
